Q00255_Tutorial/30129-001.htm.text: Hierarch Mitraell: I, the Hierarch of all Dark Elves offer you the blessings of the abyss. I am the prisoner of a magic seal, barely able to function, but I still manage to teach my students. Have you brought the Blood of Mitraell from the Newbie Helper?

Q00255_Tutorial/30129-004.htm.text: Hierarch Mitraell: Go to the Dark Elf Village and meet the newbie helper. The newbie helper will teach you many useful things.

Q00255_Tutorial/30129-003.htm.text: Hierarch Mitraell: First, you must learn the basic methods of control in the game. Let me introduce my little friend, the newbie helper . Follow his instructions, you'll quickly learn things that you'll need in the game.

villagemaster/30129.htm.text: Hierarch Mitraell: Greetings. I am Mitraell, the Hierarch of all Dark Elves. We Dark Elves have grasped the powers of black magic through the teachings of the Human Sorcerer Dasparion, but he has betrayed us, leading to my present situation. links.text: "I will go to the Dark Elven Village."
"I will go to the Kamael Village."

Q00255_Tutorial/30129-005.htm.text: Hierarch Mitraell: Go speak to the Newbie Guide in Kamael Village . He will advise you about what to do next, as well as give you a useful gift. To find him, just follow the arrow above your head. Farewell and good luck!

Q00255_Tutorial/30129-006.htm.text: Hierarch Mitraell: Go to the Dark Elven Village and speak to the Newbie Guide there. He will advise you about what to do next, as well as give you a useful gift. To find him, just follow the arrow above your head. Farewell and good luck!
